learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how big companies manage their public image, communicate with employees, and handle major crises through the power of Public Relations!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: It is how a company communicates with its internal audiences (employees, management) and external audiences (customers, media, investors) to maintain a positive and unified brand identity.

PR is the deliberate, planned, and sustained effort to establish and maintain mutual understanding between an organization and its public. Unlike advertising, PR aims to earn trust rather than just buy space.
Internal communication keeps employees motivated and informed (via newsletters, intranet). External communication builds the company's image in the outside world (via media, social media, events).

When something goes wrong (e.g., a product recall or scandal), PR professionals step in to communicate transparently, apologize if necessary, and protect the company's reputation from long-term damage.
PR professionals use Press Releases (official statements sent to journalists), Press Conferences, sponsorships, corporate social responsibility (CSR) activities, and social media to manage image.

fun_activity.title: 🚨 The PR Crisis Simulation
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are the PR Manager for a famous chocolate company. Someone spread a rumor on Twitter that your chocolate contains plastic! Write a 2-sentence official statement (a mini Press Release) to calm the public down and state the facts.

exam_tips: 📌 Know the key difference: Advertising is PAID media (buying an ad slot), while PR is EARNED media (getting a news outlet to write a positive story about you).
📌 Mention 'Stakeholders'—anyone affected by the company (employees, customers, investors, government).
📌 Highlight that good PR is 'sustained'—it's a long-term strategy, not a one-time event.
quick_recap: ⭐ A good corporate image helps a company survive during times of crisis.
⭐ Internal communication is just as important as external; happy employees make the best brand ambassadors.
⭐ Press releases and press conferences are standard tools to disseminate official company information to the media.
